Expected behavior: Schedule tasks in available time around fixed items.

Candidate entry point: Schedule > Auto Schedule
Candidate behavior and boundaries: The schedule form opens at 09:00–23:55, with a configurable buffer (initially 0) and assumed duration (initially 15 minutes). An explicit estimate takes priority. Candidate evidence: Schedule suite covers default and explicit duration, exact fits, overlapping meetings, locked work, overflow and the 13:00/15:30 milestone with a disk relaunch.
Open reference check: On a future day, add one unestimated task and a fixed meeting. Compare outputs using a 15-minute assumed duration and then a different value.
